summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on retrieving specific session data, including the `device_session_53` table. A key discussion point was determining if 'trusted sessions' could be generated for a specific date range (April 28-30) for certain units/boxes.

It was clarified that the initial data filtering might have been limited by the rollout of new firmware. To address this, someone agreed to review and potentially adjust the data scope. 

Later, regarding session attributes, it was discussed whether `is_trusted` should include all real and local trusted packets. The decision was made to add a new field, `is_data`, to allow for better segmentation of packet types.
decisions: A new field, `is_data`, will be added to the data set to segment different packet types.
action_items: Someone needs to review and adjust the scope of session data (specifically regarding trusted sessions for April 28-30).
